entries.ro: Șșș! Nu te uita în sus.

entries.en: They don't give a shit about us, girl. Night City tourists is what they’re all about.
entries.ro: Le doare-n cot de noi, fată. Pe turiștii din Night City îi vor.

entries.en: Sometimes late at night, I hear these sawing noises. Uuugh. The thought alone sends chills down my spine.
entries.ro: Uneori, noaptea, aud zgomote de fierăstrău. Uuugh. Doar gândul îmi dă fiori.

entries.en: Yeah. They came out of the Scraper again. Better keep our heads down.
entries.ro: Da. Au ieșit iar din Scraper. Mai bine ținem capul jos.

entries.en: I taught myself to block out any noises coming from the Scraper.
entries.ro: M-am obișnuit să ignor zgomotele care vin din Scraper.
